delivered_quality: successful judge quality; zero for final provider failure
task_model_quality: mean of exactly three delivered-quality repeats
cost: sum of billed cost over all attempts
service_latency: sum of provider-call wall time over all attempts; queue wait and retry backoff excluded

frozen_legacy_exception.reason: The first collector stored only the final attempt usage before this accounting protocol was frozen.
frozen_legacy_exception.cost_rule: three times the recorded final-attempt cost because all three attempts used the identical prompt and returned empty content
frozen_legacy_exception.latency_rule: use recorded end-to-end wall time as a conservative upper bound

interruption_note: At protocol freeze, up to four in-flight HTTP requests were cancelled. Their billing status is not observable; they are operational events, not completed keys, and no response outcome was inspected.
